parties: Aegis Logistics Limited (issuer); qualified institutional buyers
headline: Aegis Logistics closes ₹3,500-crore QIP; 28.93 million shares allocated at ₹1,210
sum: Issue closed 16 November 2026: Aegis' fund-raising committee approved allocation of 28,925,619 shares at ₹1,210 each and adopted the placement document. The disclosed closing/allocation should not be mislabelled as a separate final allotment confirmation.
detail: Aegis Logistics's NSE disclosure confirms that its institutional placement opened on 11 November 2026 and was closed on 16 November after receipt of applications and escrow funds from eligible QIBs. Its fundraising committee approved allocation of 28,925,619 shares of face value ₹1 at ₹1,210 per share, including ₹1,209 share premium, an implied aggregate of approximately ₹3,500 crore. The 16 November placement document and confirmation-of-allocation notice were also approved. This original document records closure and allocation; a separate final allotment filing should be checked before describing the actual legal allotment as already completed. Bar & Bench separately reports AZB & Partners and Hogan Lovells Cadwalader advising the issuer on Indian and international law, and Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas and Linklaters advising the placement agents on Indian and international law. The placement agents are investment banks, not law firms.
implication: Separate issue close, share allocation and actual allotment; reconcile 28,925,619 × ₹1,210, cite the precise issuer filing for mechanics, and credit the four law firms only to their reported legal mandates.
